description: http.validateHeaderName / validateHeaderValue (got uses them at load) and setMaxIdleHTTPParsers, as Node 22.22.0's: names, lengths, ERR_INVALID_HTTP_TOKEN, ERR_HTTP_INVALID_HEADER_VALUE, ERR_INVALID_CHAR, the max check
argv: const http = require('http'); for (const k of ['validateHeaderName', 'validateHeaderValue', 'setMaxIdleHTTPParsers']) console.log(k, typeof http[k], http[k].name, http[k].length); const t = (l, f) => { try { console.log(l, f()); } catch (e) { console.log(l, e.name, e.code, e.message); } }; t('ok name', () => http.validateHeaderName('X-Ok_1')); t('label', () => http.validateHeaderName('a b', 'Label')); t('bad name', () => http.validateHeaderName('a b')); t('empty name', () => http.validateHeaderName('')); t('number name', () => http.validateHeaderName(5)); t('ok value', () => http.validateHeaderValue('x', 'v\tal\u00e9')); t('undefined value', () => http.validateHeaderValue('x', undefined)); t('bad value', () => http.validateHeaderValue('x', 'a\nb')); t('number value', () => http.validateHeaderValue('x', 5)); t('max ok', () => http.setMaxIdleHTTPParsers(5)); t('max zero', () => http.setMaxIdleHTTPParsers(0)); t('max type', () => http.setMaxIdleHTTPParsers('1'));
